65262-the-fritz-strafers-a-story-of-the-.title: A Story Of The Great War
65262-the-fritz-strafers-a-story-of-the-.creator: Percy F. Westerman
65262-the-fritz-strafers-a-story-of-the-.description: A book by Percy F. Westerman. "QUITE right for once, Moke. Young brothers are unmitigated nuisances," declared Hugh Holcombe. "If I hadn't been such a silly owl to let my young brother try his luck with my motor-bike, I wouldn't be sitting here in this muggy carriage. Any sign of Slogger yet?"

arxiv-2102-01319.title: A Graph-Constrained Changepoint Learning Approach for Automatic QRS-Complex Detection
arxiv-2102-01319.creator: Atiyeh Fotoohinasab, Toby Hocking, Fatemeh Afghah
arxiv-2102-01319.description: Abstract This study presents a new viewpoint on ECG signal analysis by applying a graph-based changepoint detection model to locate R-peak positions. This model is based on a new graph learning algorithm to learn the constraint graph given the labeled ECG data.

arxiv-2103-04308.title: Power law duality in classical and quantum mechanics
arxiv-2103-04308.creator: Akira Inomata, Georg Junker
arxiv-2103-04308.description: Abstract The Newton–Hooke duality and its generalization to arbitrary power laws in classical, semiclassical and quantum mechanics are discussed. We pursue a view that the power-law duality is a symmetry of the action under a set of duality operations. The power dual symmetry is defined by invariance and reciprocity of the action in the form of Hamilton’s characteristic function.

arxiv-2112-07325.title: Spanning Trees of Recursive Scale-Free Graphs
arxiv-2112-07325.creator: C. Tyler Diggans, Erik M. Bollt, Daniel ben-Avraham
arxiv-2112-07325.description: Abstract We present a link-by-link rule-based method for constructing all members of the ensemble of spanning trees for any recursively generated, finitely articulated graph, such as the DGM net. The recursions allow for many large-scale properties of the ensemble of spanning trees to be analytically solved exactly.

arxiv-2209-14348.title: Deforming Active Droplets in Viscoelastic Media
arxiv-2209-14348.creator: Prateek Dwivedi, Atishay Shrivastava, Dipin Pillai, Naveen Tiwari, and Rahul Mangal
arxiv-2209-14348.description: Abstract To mimic the motion of biological swimmers in bodily fluids, a novel experimental system of micellar solubilization driven active droplets in a visco-elastic polymeric solution is presented. The visco-elastic nature of the medium, characterized by the Deborah number ( D ​ e De ), is tuned by varying the surfactant (fuel) and polymer concentration in the ambient medium.

arxiv-2305-04942.title: Primordial Black Holes from Supercooled Phase Transitions
arxiv-2305-04942.creator: Yann Gouttenoire, Tomer Volansky
arxiv-2305-04942.description: Abstract Cosmological first-order phase transitions (1stOPTs) are said to be strongly supercooled when the nucleation temperature is much smaller than the critical temperature. These are often encountered in theories that admit a nearly scale-invariant potential, for which the bounce action decreases only logarithmically with temperature.

arxiv-2305-05934.title: CAN PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS PRESERVE THE SPARSITY IN FACTOR LOADINGS?
arxiv-2305-05934.creator: Jie Wei, Yonghui Zhang
arxiv-2305-05934.description: Abstract This paper studies the principal component analysis (PCA) estimation of weak factor models with sparse loadings. We uncover an intrinsic near-sparsity preservation property for the PCA estimators of loadings, which comes from the approximately (block) upper triangular structure of the rotation matrix.

arxiv-2401-15815.title: Success probability of the L 0 L_{0} -regularized box-constrained Babai point and column permutation strategies
arxiv-2401-15815.creator: Xiao-Wen Chang and Yingzi Xu
arxiv-2401-15815.description: Abstract We consider the success probability of the L 0 L_{0} -regularized box-constrained Babai point, which is a suboptimal solution to the L 0 L_{0} -regularized box-constrained integer least squares problem and can be used for MIMO detection. First, we derive formulas for the success probability of both L 0 L_{0} -regularized and unregularized box-constrained Babai points.

arxiv-2402-02896.title: LLM Agents in Interaction: Measuring Personality Consistency and Linguistic Alignment in Interacting Populations of Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-02896.creator: Ivar Frisch, Mario Giulianelli
arxiv-2402-02896.description: Abstract While both agent interaction and personalisation are vibrant topics in research on large language models (LLMs), there has been limited focus on the effect of language interaction on the behaviour of persona-conditioned LLM agents. Such an endeavour is important to ensure that agents remain consistent to their assigned traits yet are able to engage in open, naturalistic dialogues.

arxiv-2402-12408.title: ModelGPT: Unleashing LLM’s Capabilities for Tailored Model Generation
arxiv-2402-12408.creator: Zihao Tang, Zheqi Lv, Shengyu Zhang, Fei Wu, Kun Kuang
arxiv-2402-12408.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized various sectors by automating routine tasks, marking a step toward the realization of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). However, they still struggle to accommodate the diverse and specific needs of users and simplify the utilization of AI models for the average user.

arxiv-2406-18468.title: Convergence of Tsirelson convolution systems of probability spaces Thanks: The first author was supported by a Discovery Grant from NSERC
arxiv-2406-18468.creator: Remus Floricel, Patrick Melanson
arxiv-2406-18468.description: Abstract . We associate two specific projective systems of probability spaces to any Tsirelson convolution system. If the corresponding projective limit (in the sense of Bochner) exists, we say that the system is convergent in the first case and K K -convergent in the second.

arxiv-2408-04801.title: The effect of Reynolds number on the separated flow over a low-aspect-ratio wing
arxiv-2408-04801.creator: Luke Smith, Kunihiko Taira
arxiv-2408-04801.description: Abstract At high incidence, low-aspect-ratio wings present a unique set of aerodynamic characteristics, including flow separation, vortex shedding, and unsteady force production. Furthermore, low-aspect ratio wings exhibit a highly impactful tip vortex, which introduces strong spanwise gradients into an already complex flow.

arxiv-2412-13912.title: Energy-Efficient SLAM via Joint Design of Sensing, Communication, and Exploration Speed
arxiv-2412-13912.creator: Zidong Han, Ruibo Jin, Xiaoyang Li, Bingpeng Zhou, Qinyu Zhang and Yi Gong 1 Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China2 Harbin Institute of Technoglogy (Shenzhen), Shenzhen, China3 Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data, The Chinese University of Hong Kong - Shenzhen, China4 Th
arxiv-2412-13912.description: Abstract To support future spatial machine intelligence applications, lifelong simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) has drawn significant attentions. SLAM is usually realized based on various types of mobile robots performing simultaneous and continuous sensing and communication. This paper focuses on analyzing the energy efficiency of robot operation for lifelong SLAM by jointly considering sensing, communication and mechanical factors.

arxiv-2506-19743.title: NEAR 2 : A Nested Embedding Approach to Efficient Product Retrieval and Ranking
arxiv-2506-19743.creator: Shenbin Qian, Diptesh Kanojia, Samarth Agrawal, Hadeel Saadany, Swapnil Bhosale, Constantin Orasan, Zhe Wu
arxiv-2506-19743.description: Abstract E-commerce information retrieval (IR) systems struggle to simultaneously achieve high accuracy in interpreting complex user queries and maintain efficient processing of vast product catalogs. The dual challenge lies in precisely matching user intent with relevant products while managing the computational demands of real-time search across massive inventories.

arxiv-2507-13036.title: Is 1:1 Always Most Powerful? Why Unequal Allocation Merits Broader Consideration
arxiv-2507-13036.creator: Lukas Pin *, Stef Baas, David S. Robertson, Sofía S. Villar
arxiv-2507-13036.description: Abstract The principle of allocating an equal number of patients to each arm in a randomized controlled trial is widely accepted as the standard strategy for maximising the trial’s statistical power. However, this long-held belief only holds true if the treatment groups have equal outcome variances, a condition that is often not met in practice.

arxiv-2601-05319.title: Accretion disc winds in X-ray binaries
arxiv-2601-05319.creator: Teo Muñoz-Darias, María Díaz Trigo, Chris Done, Gabriele Ponti, Ryota Tomaru
arxiv-2601-05319.description: Abstract Despite early theoretical expectations that large-scale, massive outflows would be triggered by accretion onto black holes and neutron stars, their presence was not firmly established until the 2000s. Since then, they have been recognised as a common, perhaps ubiquitous, feature of accretion discs in X-ray binaries.

arxiv-2602-14619.title: B orel exceptional values in several complex variables and their applications to shared values of shifts and difference operators Thanks: Typeset by AmS- L a T e X
arxiv-2602-14619.creator: Abhijit Banerjee 1 , Sujoy Majumder 2 ∗ , Jhilik Banerjee 3
arxiv-2602-14619.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate shared value problems for shifts and higher-order difference operators of meromorphic and entire functions in several complex variables. Using Nevanlinna theory in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} , we obtain new uniqueness theorems when functions share values counting or ignoring multiplicities, extending several classical one-variable results to higher dimensions.

arxiv-2603-04840.creator: Jihwan, Parsa, Kevin, Sean, Aditya, Haley, Woojae, Prakash, Xuan, Yoonjeong, Tiantian, Takfarinas, Ye, Sudarsana Reddy, Krishna S, Dani, Louis, Richard M, Shrikanth

europmc-pmc2826407.creator: Lembo T, Hampson K, Kaare MT, Ernest E, Knobel D, Kazwala RR, Haydon DT, Cleaveland S.
europmc-pmc2826407.description: Background Canine rabies causes many thousands of human deaths every year in Africa, and continues to increase throughout much of the continent. Methodology/principal findings This paper identifies four common reasons given for the lack of effective canine rabies control in Afri

pmc-11506979.title: Use of Chitosan–Iron Oxide Gels for the Removal of Cd2+ Ions from Aqueous Solutions
pmc-11506979.creator: Eduardo Mendizábal, Nely Ríos-Donato, Minerva Guadalupe Ventura-Muñoz, Rosaura Hernández-Montelongo, Ilse Paulina Verduzco-Navarro, Rie Kakehashi, Yuji Yamashita
pmc-11506979.description: High-quality water availability is substantial for sustaining life, so its contamination presents a serious problem that has been the focus of several studies. The presence of heavy metals, such as cadmium, is frequently studied due to the increase in the contamination levels caused by fast industrial expansion. Cadmium ions were removed from aqueous solutions at pH 7.

pmc-11691156.title: TRAJECTORY OF DECLINING PHYSICAL FUNCTION AMONG NURSING HOME RESIDENTS IN JAPAN
pmc-11691156.creator: Kasumi Ikuta, Maiko Noguchi-Watanabe, Miya Aishima, Sakiko Fukui
pmc-11691156.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The timing and speed of physical function decline among nursing home residents vary, and the decline trajectory remains unclear. Therefore, this multicenter retrospective study was aimed at identifying the trajectory of declining physical function among Japanese nursing home residents. We included new nursing home residents who were admitted between July 2021 and March 2023, who had a high physical function score (Barthel Index [BI]: >60), and whose physical function declined during the period from admission to 6 months after.

pmc-12359970.title: The potential of plant-derived vesicles in treating periodontitis and associated systemic diseases: current advances and future directions
pmc-12359970.creator: Zongshuai Liu, Yonglin Guo, Yifei Deng, Juhua Shao, Xin Huang, Zhengguo Cao
pmc-12359970.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis, a chronic multifactorial inflammatory disease, represents a significant public health burden among global chronic non-communicable diseases. In addition to affecting oral health, periodontitis is closely associated with a variety of systemic diseases. Current treatments, including surgical and nonsurgical therapies, lack clear superiority, underscoring the need for innovative therapeutic strategies.

pmc-12860579.title: Fahr’s Syndrome Secondary to Hypoparathyroidism Presenting With Neurological and Cardiac Manifestations
pmc-12860579.creator: India Elliott, Shailesh Dalvi, King Leong, Stephanie Wong
pmc-12860579.description: Fahr’s syndrome is characterised by bilateral intracranial calcifications secondary to systemic or metabolic disease. We report a 56-year-old man with Fahr’s syndrome due to hypoparathyroidism who presented with collapse and seizure-like activity during alcohol consumption. Laboratory investigations demonstrated chronic hypocalcaemia with suppressed parathyroid hormone and hyperphosphataemia.

pmc-13062385.title: Non-neoplastic Orthopedic Pathology – A Systematic Review
pmc-13062385.creator: Anusha Palaniswamy, Karthik Shunmugavelu, Evangeline Cynthia Dhinakaran
pmc-13062385.description: Introduction:From inflammatory to neoplastic disorders, a variety of pathological bone lesions can manifest. Only 0.5% of all cancer kinds are bone tumors, making them comparatively rare. Cartilaginous, osteoid, fibrous, and bone marrow components make up bone. Benign or malignant tumors can develop in any tissue.

pmc-13176509.title: Decoding immune‐driven erythroid failure in pure red cell aplasia
pmc-13176509.creator: Federico Spataro, Vanessa Desantis, Antonio Giovanni Solimando
pmc-13176509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pure red cell aplasia (PRCA) is increasingly recognised as a T‐cell‐mediated bone marrow failure syndrome, yet its immunogenetic drivers remain poorly defined. In their paper, Yamashita et al. integrate human leucocyte antigen (HLA) typing, T‐cell receptor repertoire analysis and mutational profiling to reveal enriched HLA alleles, signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3)‐mutated T‐cell clones and a shared T cell receptor beta (TCRβ) motif in PRCA patients.

pmc-13201627.title: Mapping the avoid-ome: a systematic open-science approach to predictive ADMET
pmc-13201627.creator: James S. Fraser, Steven Edgar, L. Naomi Handly, Sriram Kosuri, John D. Chodera, Mark Murcko, W. Patrick Walters
pmc-13201627.description: Drug discovery often fails due to unpredictable ADMET issues, which account for 30% of clinical setbacks. Conventional methods lack the atomistic detail needed to navigate the “Avoid-ome”—a finite set of proteins acting as “anti-targets”. OpenADMET is an open-science initiative addressing this by creating pre-competitive, mechanistic datasets.

pmc-13281461.title: Comparative performance of artificial intelligence models in intensive care nursing questions: an evaluation of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Google Gemini
pmc-13281461.creator: Seçil Gülhan Güner, Ziya Tan, Serhat Gülpınar
pmc-13281461.description: BackgroundThe complexity and rapidly evolving nature of critical patient care in Intensive Care Units underscore the importance of the accuracy and timeliness of nursing decisions, further highlighting the significance of nursing education. This study aims to examine the accuracy of four generative artificial intelligence tools (ChatGPT 5.0 Plus, ChatGPT 5.

pmc-13289090.title: Effect of home visiting support on maternal psychosocial needs and postnatal depression: emulating a target trial
pmc-13289090.creator: Kaori Baba, Zui C Narita, Syudo Yamasaki, Tomohiro Shinozaki, Junko Niimura, Naomi Nakajima, Satoshi Yamaguchi, Gemma Knowles, Jordan Devylder, Satsuki Ayaya, Shin-ichiro Kumagaya, Daniel Stanyon, Nao Oikawa, Mariko Hosozawa, Miharu Nakanishi, Shuntaro Ando, Kiyoto Kasai, Mitsuhiro Miyashita, Mariko Hiraiwa-Hasegawa, Toshi A Furukawa, Vikram Patel, Susan M Sawyer, Atsushi Nishida

pmc-13405067.title: Induction of neutralising antibodies against conserved rhinovirus capsid protein VP4 is dependent on presentation of VP4 peptide immunogens in a virus-like conformation
pmc-13405067.creator: James T. Kelly, Giann Kerwin Y. Dellosa, Joseph Newman, Adel A. M. Mohamed, Julia Aniscenko, Sebastian L. Johnston, Jason Schnell, Tobias J. Tuthill, Caroline Tapparel, Ashley L. St. John, Ashley L. St. John, Ashley L. St. John
pmc-13405067.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Infection with rhinovirus (RV) is a frequent cause of the common cold and is also associated with more significant morbidity, including hospitalisation, in people with chronic lung disease. At present, there is no licensed RV vaccine or antiviral. There are over 150 RV strains classified into 3 species (RV-A, RV-B, RV-C), and approximately 100 of these have been characterised as distinct serotypes. There is no cross-protection between serotypes because of high diversity in immunodominant antigenic sites.

pmc-13530583.title: Poster 28. Sex-Specific Implications in Extensor Autograft Selection from an ACL Reconstruction Return-to-Sport Database
pmc-13530583.creator: Richard Ma, Chelsea Harrison, Lindsey Colbert, David Echelmeyer, Hongjie Huang
pmc-13530583.description: Objective:Patient outcomes following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) are influenced by a complex relationship of patient demographic, surgical, and postoperative rehabilitation factors. Extensor mechanism-based autografts (e.g., bone-patellar-tendon bone autograft; BPTB, and quadriceps tendon autograft; QT) are popular graft choices for ACLR. There is limited understanding on the rehabilitation impact of type of extensor autograft used in ACLR and patient sex.

pmc-13667946.title: Dexmedetomidine versus midazolam during total thyroidectomy with intraoperative neuromonitoring: A prospective non-randomized study
pmc-13667946.creator: Suat Evirgen, Harun Tolga Duran, Bülent Meriç Çam, Mürsel Kahveci, Osman Özgür Kılınç, Şirin Çetin
pmc-13667946.description: Anesthetic adjuncts may influence intraoperative neuromonitoring (IONM) during thyroidectomy. We compared dexmedetomidine and midazolam as adjuncts to propofol-based total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA). This prospective, single-center, non-randomized, unblinded study included 60 adults undergoing elective total thyroidectomy with intermittent IONM, assigned alternately to dexmedetomidine or midazolam (30 per group).
